column1: # p576 / 576-E — the grant classifier is ENGLISH-ONLY, demonstrated against its own regex.
# Regex under test, copied from compose/code/p228-shelf-gate/classify_grant.py line 29:
# Run with python3 -I against the two bodies below.  The repository is plainly AGPL-3.0;
# the classifier cannot see it, because the title is translated AND reordered.
GNU AFFERO GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3, 19 November 2007
LICENÇA PÚBLICA GERAL AFFERO GNU Versão 3, 19 de novembro de 2007 (portabilis/i-diario, branch 1.6, LICENSE, 35,325 B)
# Consequence: in a base whose stated purpose includes LATAM coverage, the licence
# classifier is blind to licence files written in the region's own languages.  A
# Portuguese or Spanish AGPL/GPL body reads as ungranted, which is the DANGEROUS
# direction: an unseen copyleft grant looks like "no licence" and then like "ours".
